quest.title: The Great Tree: State of Growth
quest.description: Yasmin seems to be up to something...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still working on the roots of the Divine Tree?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, you are always showing up just in time...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Many thanks for all your help. The Divine Tree is now in perfect condition.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: After discussing the matter with Ladep, we think it should be able to stay in that condition for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Now we can finally dedicate some time to preparing our theses.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: See, I borrowed a Kamera from Pharez, which I am going to use to record the condition of the Divine Tree.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you take a picture of the Divine Tree in its entirety? I have marked the spot on your map.

choices.text: Why can't you do it yourself?

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Well, it's... too high up for me...

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: I've always been terrified of being in high places on my own... The feeling of being blown away... Or losing my manuscript to a gust of wind keeps coming to me...

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Pharez is usually the one up there, but he seems to have other things to attend to right now. You're the only one I can rely on, Traveler.

talks.objective: Take a picture of the Divine Tree in its entirety at the designated location

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Please take a picture of the Divine Tree in its entirety. I'm counting on you, Traveler.

talks.objective: Take a picture of the Divine Tree in its entirety

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you take the picture?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Well done. Perfectly angled, and the image is pretty clear as well.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Here is your payment. Thank you for helping me, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: The trunk is fine... And the shape of surrounding branches hasn't changed...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Great, I'll wait till Ladep and Pharez finish gathering their data, and we can move on to the next subject.
